name: Resortlife
summary:
Resortlife is a destination management company based in Malé, working with Maldives resorts since 2006. This app puts our 360° resort tours in your headset, so you can see where you would stay before you ask about a trip.

What you can do
• Choose from more than 40 Maldives resorts on a wall of islands. Look at one and you are standing above it.
• Step inside overwater villas, beach villas, restaurants, spas, pools and jetties, photographed in 360°.
• Move the way you like: follow the rings from room to roo
